known-limit-01.outside_accept_list: Non-JSON roots may establish a media limit. They do not establish the source level of a Swagger media declaration.

input.operation: Decode the seeded change, limit and affected_claims rows as impact wire records.

observed.comparison: The affected_claims and change rows come from fixture patches.
observed.scope: The case verifies retained limits and links without deriving these rows from SchemaDiff.

known-limit-02.outside_accept_list: A wire fixture is evidence of wire behavior only. It cannot certify production selection of affected claims.

control.input: Project a real empty-to-Swagger diff in fold_root_limit_preserves_unknown_field_details and fold2_operation_addition_without_fields_does_not_inherit_media_limit.
control.observed: A root limit links to its unknown field detail and stands alone when the operation has no matching detail.

known-limit-03.outside_accept_list: The frozen impact validator supports a historical cutoff whose subject head is the effective after commit. It cannot resolve a distinct topic head through merge evidence.

control.input: Make service-after the effective subject commit, timestamp it at cutoff and select it as subject_head_input_id.

known-limit-04.finding: Sol B, omitted comparison and usages
known-limit-04.outside_accept_list: The validator checks comparisons and usages that are present. Completeness of the required pair population only comes from the admitted producer path.

control.input: Keep all four comparisons and their usage references. Removing only the service_first usage link then yields a counted refusal.

known-limit-05.finding: Sol B, frozen negative contradicting a saved match
known-limit-05.outside_accept_list: The validator checks local status invariants and resolved IDs. Frozen scan and status contents cannot certify a saved negative.

control.input: Run saved_binding_status on exact admitted selected and saved inventories with a complete segment and zero saved matches.

known-limit-06.finding: Sol C, bindings attachment with different bytes
known-limit-06.outside_accept_list: Matching origin labels do not authorize replacement bytes. Supported attachments come from the same admitted digest and dependency closure.

control.input: Build the index from the admitted entry for producer.json with its original digest.

known-limit-07.finding: Sol C, saved inventory with an unadmitted reference
known-limit-07.outside_accept_list: Entry bytes and origin identity do not establish the bytes of a referenced document. The saved index must come from the scan's admitted dependency closure.

control.input: Use self-contained admitted inventory bytes and their derived signature with otherwise identical saved and selected evidence.

known-limit-08.finding: Sol D, unrelated complete membership region
known-limit-08.outside_accept_list: A membership negative needs complete evidence across every applicable region. A neighboring prefix supplies no negative evidence for the queried path.

control.input: Use the same empty operations and complete API-wide file_status.

known-limit-09.outside_accept_list: The standalone schema checks portable bounds and null rules. The inequality between sibling properties requires typed validation.

known-limit-10.outside_accept_list: Unknown keys invalidate the whole versioned admission envelope. Claim-local refusal and sibling preservation apply after successful decode.

control.input: Keep the key known and change /receipts/0/kind to future.
